codec_shape.decodeReference: (dictionary : List Payload) → (reference : Key × Nat) → Option (Key × Payload), implemented as dictionary[reference.2]?.map (fun payload => (reference.1, payload))
codec_shape.unpack: (packed : Packed Key Payload) → Option (List (Key × Payload)), implemented as packed.references.mapM (decodeReference packed.dictionary)
codec_shape.pack: [DecidableEq Payload] → (entries : List (Key × Payload)) → Packed Key Payload, dictionary := (entries.map Prod.snd).dedup; references := entries.map (fun entry => (entry.1, dictionary.idxOf entry.2))

theorems.decodeReference_index_of_mem: payload ∈ dictionary → decodeReference dictionary (key, dictionary.idxOf payload) = some (key, payload)
theorems.unpack_map_indices: (∀ entry ∈ entries, entry.2 ∈ dictionary) → (entries.map (fun entry => (entry.1, dictionary.idxOf entry.2))).mapM (decodeReference dictionary) = some entries
